guide:
Final Simulation 1: Trading Business

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

ध्यान दें

दरें GST 2.0 (22-Sep-2025 से लागू) के अनुसार हैं। Practice में Question की दी हुई दर ही लगाएँ।

सबसे पहले — Simulation का क्रम (हर बार यही)

  • Company बनाएँ (State, GSTIN) और F11 में GST, Inventory आदि Features चालू करें।
  • Masters बनाएँ: Groups/Ledgers (Bank, Cash, Capital, Parties, Expenses), Duties & Taxes (CGST, SGST, IGST), Stock Items (HSN, GST दर), Godown।
  • Opening Balances भरें (Capital, Cash, Bank, Stock) और Trial Balance मिलाएँ।
  • सारे Vouchers तारीख़ के क्रम में डालें: Purchase → Sales → Credit/Debit Note → Payment/Receipt → Expenses।
  • हर बड़े चरण के बाद Trial Balance जाँचें (Dr = Cr)।
  • अंत में रिपोर्ट: Stock Summary, Outstanding (Receivables/Payables), GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, P&L, Balance Sheet।
  • आख़िर में Backup लें (Alt+Y → Backup)।

problems.title: Divya Fashion House — Garment Trading, One Full Cycle
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

GST 5% on all Garments, Local (Intra-State, CGST+SGST)। Company: Divya Fashion House, Jaipur, Rajasthan.

  • 1st April — Opening Capital introduced: Cash ₹ 2,00,000; HDFC Bank ₹ 5,00,000
  • 1st April — Purchased from Rajasthan Textiles (Local, Regular): 200 Pcs Kurti @ ₹350; 150 Pcs Saree @ ₹600 (Bill No. RT-01, 30 Days Credit)
  • 2nd April — Sold to Meena Boutique (Local, Regular): 80 Pcs Kurti @ ₹450; 60 Pcs Saree @ ₹750
  • 2nd April — Sold to Priya Garments, Delhi (Inter-State, Regular): 50 Pcs Kurti @ ₹460; 40 Pcs Saree @ ₹760
  • 30th April — Paid ₹ 80,000 to Rajasthan Textiles by Cheque (part payment)
  • 30th April — Received ₹ 70,000 from Meena Boutique by Cheque (part payment)

problems.title: Chaudhary Enterprises — Mobile Trading, Local + Inter-State, Returns, Receipts (Complete)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Firm: Chaudhary Enterprises, Delhi, GSTIN 07ABCPC4321D1ZH। Opening (1st April): Cash ₹ 1,00,000; HDFC Bank ₹ 14,00,000; Capital ₹ 15,00,000। सभी Items पर GST 18%। Stock Valuation = Weighted Average।

  • 2nd April — Purchase from GS Traders, Delhi (Local, GSTIN 07AAECG5632J1ZJ), Bill GS-101: 20 Pcs Samsung A-series @ ₹15,000; 30 Pcs Redmi Note @ ₹10,000; 25 Pcs Realme C-series @ ₹12,000
  • 3rd April — Purchase from Noida Mobiles, Uttar Pradesh (Inter-State, GSTIN 09AAFCN7788K1ZK), Bill NM-77: 20 Pcs Redmi Note @ ₹10,500; 100 Pcs Charger 25W @ ₹400
  • 5th April — Sale to Mehta Telecom, Delhi (Local, GSTIN 07AAAFM4455L1Z4), Inv. 1: 10 Pcs Samsung A-series @ ₹17,500; 25 Pcs Redmi Note @ ₹12,000
  • 6th April — Sale to Capital Mobiles, Haryana (Inter-State, GSTIN 06AADCC1209M1ZV), Inv. 2: 15 Pcs Realme C-series @ ₹14,500; 15 Pcs Redmi Note @ ₹12,500; 60 Pcs Charger 25W @ ₹600
  • 8th April — Mehta Telecom ने 2 Pcs Samsung A-series (Defective) लौटाए → Credit Note (मूल Invoice Link करें)
  • 10th April — GS Traders को ₹ 5,00,000 NEFT (HDFC); Noida Mobiles को पूरा भुगतान NEFT
  • 12th April — Mehta Telecom से ₹ 3,00,000 UPI (HDFC); Capital Mobiles से ₹ 3,00,000 NEFT (HDFC)
  • 15th April — Rent ₹ 25,000 (HDFC, GST नहीं), Salary ₹ 40,000 (HDFC), Electricity ₹ 6,000 (Cash)

Required: Trial Balance, GST Liability/ITC (GSTR-3B), Party-wise Outstanding, Closing Stock, Gross Profit, Cash/Bank Balance निकालिए।
